citations.quote: submitting a sell limit order is similar to writing an American call option

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: In a continuous LOB a limit order is a free option offering price improvement but bearing non-execution and pick-off (adverse-selection) risk, while a market order pays the spread for immediacy; equilibrium order choice trades these off.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Limit Order Book Markets: The Limit-vs-Market Order Choice as an Option
